bias.zh: 反弹 · 抛物线 SAR 翻多，站上 $37.8–38.6

read.en: MP Materials rose 3.5% on Nov 13 to $38.76, trading $37.21–39.75 on heavy volume (1.32x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($37.43, rising) and 10-day ($36.84) and below the 30-day ($40.16), 100-day ($47.67) and 200-day ($53.72), all falling. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 9, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 13 ($31.90), and RSI is 46.8.
read.zh: MP Materials 11月13日上涨 3.5%，收于 $38.76，盘中区间 $37.21–39.75，成交量放大（20 日均量的 1.32 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$37.43，上行）和 10 日均线（$36.84）上方，30 日（$40.16）、100 日（$47.67）和 200 日均线（$53.72）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 11月9日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 于 11月13日翻为看多（$31.90），RSI 为 46.8。

read.en: The close cleared the $37.8–38.6 band (Jul 29 low, Nov 12 high), now support; the $39.75 high stopped short of the 30-day. Resistance is $39.8–40.2 (Nov 13 high, 30-day), then $40.9 (Nov 2 high) and $42.5 (Oct 29 high). Support is $37.8–38.6, then $36.7–37.4 (5 and 10-day, Nov 11 low) and $35.6. A close above $40.2 would target $40.9–42.5; below $37.8, $36.7–37.4.
